criteria.target: bash -c 'grep -q STALE scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.sh && grep -q "missing runtime dependency" scripts/verify-packaged-runtime.sh'

$comment: The check used to be a MODULES=(...) list of six dist paths. Adding a fake line was how it was maintained, and a deleted module then misdiagnosed as a missing dependency. Entry points are now enumerated from package.json main/bin/exports, the static import graph of those files, and every shipped dist/src/**/*.js that imports a third-party package. STALE still means enumerated-but-absent; FAIL still means the import cannot resolve.
